projects.name: VidCutAI
projects.summary: AI-driven multicam podcast editor with client-side processing
projects.description: Automated multicam podcast editing using AI-powered speaker diarization and intelligent angle selection. Processes audio and video locally for privacy and speed, then exports to Final Cut Pro XML format.

projects.name: Pro Transcribe
projects.description: Flask-based web application for reliable transcription and speaker diarization with a simple, intuitive workflow. Handles uploads, job management, and multiple export formats.

projects.name: Behavior Data Tracker
projects.summary: Special-needs behavior tracking app for educational environments
projects.description: iOS app built with Swift and Objective-C for tracking behavior data in special-needs educational settings. Improved data capture and analysis for staff and students.

projects.name: Homelab Infrastructure
projects.summary: GPU-powered private cloud for AI inference and media processing
projects.description: Self-hosted infrastructure with pfSense firewall, QNAP NAS storage, Ubuntu GPU servers, and segmented VLANs. Supports VidCutAI processing and hosts experiments.
